### Bug Scenario and Root Cause

The bug scenario involves running Lighthouse (LH) on a URL, such as `https://www.google.com/`, and encountering a `NO_FCP` (No First Contentful Paint) error when the tab is in the background. This error prevents the measurement of performance metrics. The issue occurs in the Lighthouse extension but not in the CLI, indicating a problem with how the extension handles background tabs.

The root cause is likely related to the way the extension manages page lifecycle events when the tab is not in focus. The `NO_FCP` error suggests that the First Contentful Paint event is not being detected, possibly due to the tab being in the background and not actively rendering content.

### Bug Localization

The relevant code snippets are in `lighthouse-core/gather/driver.js` and `lighthouse-core/gather/gather-runner.js`. The issue is likely in the handling of lifecycle events or the configuration of the tracing categories that capture these events.

### Patches
